title: Ox Passion Melon Banana Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Melon Banana blends the delicate sweetness of ripe Melon with the creamy richness of soft Banana, creating a smooth and mellow fruit vape. The Melon note adds a fresh, juicy brightness, while the Banana rounds out the flavour with a velvety finish. This gently layered combination is ideal for vapers who enjoy a more subtle, soothing fruit profile. Formulated with nicotine salts for smooth throat hits and fast nicotine absorption, this e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio and optimised for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. It performs best in low-powered pod vape kits, starter devices, and compact refillable systems. Available in both 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, OX Passion Nic Salts offer bold, layered flavour profiles with a consistently smooth finish. Developed by Oxva, a trusted name in vaping hardware, these e-liquids are expertly crafted to pair seamlessly with Oxva XLIM pod kits and other refillable MTL vape devices.
